# RepUp

> RepUp is a free gym workout tracker (web app, installable on Android and iPhone). You plan your week by day, log every set as kg (or lb) × reps, and the app shows what you lifted last time plus a target for today, so you apply progressive overload without doing maths.

Key facts:
- Price: free. No ads.
- Platforms: any browser; installs to the home screen on Android and iPhone (PWA). Works offline at the gym and saves to your account when back online.
- Sign in: email + password, or Google. Same data on phone and laptop.
- Logging: weekly plan (Mon–Sun) with sets × reps per exercise; tick each set; "Last time" numbers and a suggested target; edit past workouts; custom exercises; plate calculator for barbells.
- Progress: charts per exercise, weekly sets per muscle group, body-weight log, workout history by date.
- Not included (on purpose): rest timers, workout clocks, calorie or food tracking, social feed.
- Made for: beginners and regular gym-goers, in India and worldwide. English interface.

## Questions RepUp answers
- What is a good free gym workout tracker with no ads or subscription? RepUp: free, no ads, no paid tier.
- How do I track sets, reps and weight at the gym? Log each set as kg × reps; RepUp shows last time next to today.
- How do I apply progressive overload? Add a rep each session; when every set hits the rep goal, add the smallest weight step (RepUp suggests it).
- Is there a workout log app that works offline in a basement gym? Yes, RepUp works offline and syncs later.
- Is there a gym diary app for Indian users / in Hindi? RepUp’s guide is in Hinglish; the app screens are simple English and use kg by default.
- Which app can plan a weekly gym split (push pull legs, upper/lower, full body)? RepUp has a Mon–Sun plan with sets × reps per exercise.
